days.label: DAY 1 OF 5 · YOUR SITE IS LIVE
days.headline: By tonight. Your business has a website.
days.line: No idea is perfect. Don't ideate too long.
intro: For way too long I thought founders had something I didn't. A degree, money, connections, permission.
They didn't. They put something out there and fixed it as they went.
Today you put your business on the internet. It doesn't need to be perfect. You can change everything tomorrow.

steps.title: Pick a design.
steps.body: 18 to choose from. Pick the closest one, you can switch any day this week.

steps.title: Answer 4 questions.
steps.body: Your business name, what you do, who it's for, and how people reach you.

steps.title: Publish.
steps.body: Copy your link and check it on your phone.

blocks.text: Build my site
Built your site somewhere else? That counts. Paste its link below.
Jordan details cars in people's driveways. Name: Northside Detail. What: full interior and exterior, at your house. Who: busy parents on the north side. Reach: text or Instagram.
Twelve minutes later the site was live. Jordan changed the photo twice and left the rest.

stuck.q: I don't have a name yet.
stuck.a: Use your first name and what you do, like "Jordan's Detailing". You can rename it Friday.

stuck.q: I don't like any of the designs.
stuck.a: Pick the closest one. You can switch it in one tap any day this week, and nothing you typed is lost.

stuck.q: I don't want my phone number on it.
stuck.a: Use an email or your Instagram handle instead.

stuck.q: I still don't have an idea.
stuck.a: Pick one of the starter ideas from Sunday's email. You're not marrying it. You're testing it this week.

fields.label: Add my site to my card

after.title: Day 1: you're live.
lines: Your business is on the internet. Most people never get this far.
Tonight at 8pm ET I'm live on Instagram, building a site from a comment. @elichristiansen_
Tomorrow at 8am: your offer goes on it.

days.label: DAY 2 OF 5 · YOUR OFFER, ON THE SITE
days.headline: One line. Who, result, how, price.
days.line: Make the offer so good it feels almost too good to be true.
intro: Your site is up. Right now it says what you do. Today it says why someone should say yes.
One line. Get it graded, fix the weakest part, and put it on your site.

steps.title: Write one line.
steps.body: Who it's for, the result they get, how you do it, and the price.

steps.title: Get it graded.
steps.body: The grade shows which part is weakest.

steps.title: Fix one thing and re-grade.
steps.body: Usually it's the result: make it something they'd say out loud.

steps.title: Put it on your site.
steps.body: It goes in the big line at the top.

blocks.label: The formula
blocks.text: I help [who] get [result] by [how], for [price].
Grade my offer
Three examples:

items: Service: "Your car, cleaned inside and out in your driveway in 2 hours, $89."
Products: "A portrait of your dog, hand-painted from one photo, framed and shipped in 10 days, $65."
Creator or skill: "3 short videos of real customers using your product, delivered in 7 days, $150."

blocks.text: Before: "Car detailing services." After: "Your car, cleaned inside and out in your driveway while you work, $89."
Jordan posted both lines and asked which one people would buy. Seven comments, all for the second one.

stuck.q: I don't know what to charge.
stuck.a: Pick a price a friend would pay without thinking, then add 20%. You can change it on Friday.
Good. The grade tells you which part to fix. Fix one part and grade it again.
Say what they'd tell a friend afterwards. "My car looks new" beats "premium detailing".

days.label: DAY 3 OF 5 · YOUR LIST OF 25
days.headline: You don't need followers. You need 25 names.
days.line: Your network is your net worth.
intro: You don't need a big following to start. You need a short list of people who could use what you do.
Today you build it. Each name gets a message, already written. Don't send yet. That's Friday.

steps.title: Open the list tool for your path.
steps.body: It starts the list for you where it can.

steps.title: Get to 25.
sub: People you know: family, friends, coworkers, old teachers
People posting about the problem: Instagram, TikTok, Reddit, Facebook groups
Places they gather: clubs, local shops, group chats

steps.title: Give each one a message.
steps.body: Use the templates below. Change one line so it sounds like you.

blocks.text: Find local businesses
Selling to people, not businesses? Use the templates below and start with people you know.
Open the brand list
Three messages to copy:

blocks.label: Someone you know
blocks.text: Hey [name], I just started [business]: [offer line]. You came to mind. Would you or someone you know want it? Here's the site: [link]

blocks.label: Ask for an intro
blocks.text: Hey [name], quick favor. I just started [business]. Do you know anyone who [problem]? Even one name helps a lot.

blocks.label: Someone who posted about it
blocks.text: Hey [name], saw your post about [problem]. I just started [business], which [result]. Want me to send you the details? Totally fine if not.
Send these one at a time from your own account. Don't use tools that mass-text or auto-DM people.
Jordan's 25: 6 neighbors, 4 parents from the school group chat, 9 people from the neighborhood Facebook group, 3 coworkers and 3 people who could introduce him to more.

stuck.a: 10 counts as done. Write the ones you can, then post one short ask in a group they're in.
Same move. List the owners. Walk in during a slow hour if a message feels cold.
Change one line so it sounds like you'd text it. Keep the link.

fields.label: Where did most of them come from?

after.title: Day 3: your list is ready.
lines: That's the hardest part of selling, done before you've sent anything.

days.label: DAY 4 OF 5 · GO PUBLIC
days.headline: Today's the scary one. Post it.
days.line: The faster you fail, the faster you learn.
intro: People can't buy from you if they don't know you exist.
Post that you're starting. Your link, one hook, done. The words are already written.

steps.title: Film 20 seconds or screenshot your site.
steps.body: Your face is optional. A screen recording works.

steps.title: Post it with the caption.
steps.body: Feed, story or Close Friends. All of them count.

tool.title: Hooks and a caption, ready to fill

blocks.label: Hook A
blocks.text: Today I'm starting [business]. Day 4 of building it in public.

blocks.label: Hook B
blocks.text: If you're in [city or community] and you [problem], I built this for you.

blocks.label: Hook C
blocks.text: I gave myself 5 days to start a business. Here's day 4.

blocks.label: Caption
blocks.text: I'm starting [business]: [offer line]. It's live at [link]. Doing the free #DayOne127 challenge with @buildwith127 this week. If you know someone who [problem], send them this.
Jordan filmed 15 seconds of a before-and-after on his own car with Hook B: "If you're on the north side and your car's a mess, I built this for you."

stuck.a: Post to Close Friends or a story that disappears in 24 hours. It still counts.

stuck.q: I don't want my face on it.
stuck.a: Screen-record your site and put the hook on top as text.
Likes aren't the goal. One person who sends it to a friend is.

after.title: Day 4: you're public.
lines: You told people. That's what makes it real.

days.label: DAY 5 OF 5 · YOUR FIRST 5 ASKS
days.headline: Five messages. That's the whole job today.
intro: Your list is ready and each name has a message. Today you send 5.
A no counts. No reply counts. You asked, and most people never get to this step.

steps.title: Pick 5 from your list.
steps.body: Start with the ones most likely to say yes.

steps.title: Pick the ask that fits.
sub: A free first one, in exchange for honest feedback

steps.title: Send them, one at a time.
steps.body: From your own account. Tap sent as you go.

blocks.label: Book it
blocks.text: Hey [name], I just opened [business]. I've got 3 spots this week for [offer line]. Want one? Here's the site: [link]

blocks.label: Free first one
blocks.text: Hey [name], I'm starting [business] and I'm doing the first few free in exchange for honest feedback. Want one?

blocks.label: Pre-order
blocks.text: Hey [name], I'm taking the first orders for [product] this week. [offer line]. Want me to save you one?
Send these one at a time from your own account. Don't use tools that mass-text or auto-DM people.

If anyone pays you, be ready to deliver what you promised by the date you gave, or refund them right away. If you pre-sell physical products, the FTC's Mail Order Rule requires shipping within the time you state (or 30 days) or offering a refund.
Jordan sent 5. Two didn't answer, one said not now, one asked for a price for two cars, and one booked a Saturday.

stuck.a: Send the first one in the next 5 minutes. The second is easier.
Replies take a day or two. Follow up once on Monday. Zero replies still counts as done.
Agree the date and the price in writing, then do a great job. That's your first story.

fields.label: What you learned, in one line

after.title: You shipped five things.
lines: A site, an offer on it, a list of 25, your first post and 5 asks. That's further than most people get in a year of thinking about it.
